case.summary: Case SEN-008 was opened on 2016-11-21 following a Sentinel sweep on card C10990-K1 belonging to customer C10990. The investigation identified four online transactions (3475933, 3475959, 3475998, 3476008) executed within 24 minutes with amounts structured just under the $500 authorization threshold, totaling $1,926.93. With a fraud probability of 0.90, the verdict is confirmed as fraud. Recommended final actions include BLOCK_CARD routed to L1, CREATE_CASE routed to auto, and FILE_REPORT routed to L2 under §3a.

sar.narrative: Customer C10990 utilizing card C10990-K1 was subjected to fraudulent account activity on 2016-11-21. The fraudulent activity comprised four online card transactions totaling $1,926.93 under IDs 3475933, 3475959, 3475998, and 3476008. These transactions occurred on 2016-11-21 between 16:00:00 and 16:24:00. The activity was conducted entirely online through device profile chrome 64.0. The scheme involved structuring amounts just under $500 to bypass authorization thresholds. This activity is suspicious due to the rapid burst of transactions and amount manipulation. Connected cards include no additional flagged cards within the immediate review window. Regulatory and policy actions include BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, and FILE_REPORT.
